about: IIT Madras was set up in 1959 under an Indo-German agreement, declared an Institute of National Importance in 1961 and later named an Institute of Eminence. It has held the top spot in NIRF's engineering ranking every year since the framework began and the overall ranking for seven straight years. Eighteen departments span engineering, sciences, humanities, management and medical science, and doctoral scholars outnumber undergraduates on a wooded campus that also houses the IITM Research Park and incubation cell.

location.nearestRailway: Chennai Central, about 12-13 km; Kasturba Nagar MRTS adjoins the campus
location.connectivityNote: The main gate is on Sardar Patel Road between Adyar and Velachery in south Chennai. Kasturba Nagar on the MRTS line is the closest station; Guindy metro plus a short bus or auto ride is the other rail option. The airport is a 30-45 minute cab ride and Chennai Central about 45-60 minutes by road.
